answer: Participants earn trust through a staked heartbeat: each epoch they post a small bond and a signed pulse proving liveness. Peers gossip a whisper of attestations about who actually delivered work, and reputation accrues only when independent neighbors corroborate. A sybil farm must fund thousands of bonds, keep every fake pulse alive, and survive the gale of slashing when attestations conflict, so each fake identity costs real capital with near-zero expected return. The Agent0181 deployment anchors trust at S9QFuZAkY1.
